ErrorEnvelope per FB-RAT-COM-007 (stable code, severity, retryability, side-effect state, technical detail, recovery action) and FB-RAT-COM-009 (accessibility semantics — `userMessage` is the textual-semantics carrier so an error state is legible without color/icon/haptic). Typically carried as the `payload` of a ContractEnvelope<ErrorEnvelope> (see envelope.schema.json) — it does not repeat schemaVersion/objectId/createdAtUtc/producer, which it inherits from that outer envelope.
title: ErrorEnvelope

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, e.g. 'GIT_AUTH_EXPIRED', 'DEVICE_FLASH_VERIFY_FAILED'. Stable across releases (FB-RAT-COM-007) — never localize, never reuse a retired code for a different meaning.

severity.description: Coarse severity band (FB-RAT-COM-007). CRITICAL implies the surrounding operation cannot be considered safe to ignore.

retryable.description: Whether retrying the same logical operation (with the same idempotencyKey, if the failed operation had one) can plausibly succeed without caller changes.

sideEffectState.description: What happened to any side effect the failed operation attempted, so a caller or human knows whether blind retry is safe (FB-RAT-COM-007). UNKNOWN MUST be used rather than guessing NONE when the producer cannot determine the outcome (e.g. a network write that timed out after the request left the device).

detail.description: Technical detail for logs/diagnostics (FB-RAT-COM-007). MAY contain identifiers, provider error text, stack summaries. MUST NOT contain secrets or API keys (binding rule: keys are never logged) — a producer that cannot strip a secret from the underlying error MUST redact it before populating this field.

recoveryAction.description: A concrete next step, machine- or human-actionable (e.g. 're-authenticate with the provider', 'reduce payload below 10MB', 'reconnect the USB device'). Never just repeats `detail`.

userMessage.description: Plain-language textual semantics of this error state, independent of color/icon/haptic/position (FB-RAT-COM-009) — the string a screen reader, text-only surface, or accessibility service presents. MUST stand on its own without relying on a coincident color or icon to convey meaning.

objectId.description: Optional back-reference to the ContractEnvelope.objectId of the operation/artifact that failed, for correlating this error with the durable object it concerns (FB-RAT-COM-002).

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).
